## Highlights

- Delivers Bot escalation through one durable Swarm attention catalog instead of creating or injecting user chats.
- Keeps pending attention messages and their causal context reachable in the bounded Swarm Chat transcript.
- Broadcasts the same typed state used by in-app alerts and Cloud push notifications.

Protocol 64 and Swarm state v5 replace protocol 63 and Swarm state v4. Configuration 23, chat specification 14, checkpoint 13, SQLite schema 9, and Bot state 4 are unchanged.
